prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Meridian Regional ATFM+A-CDM; airports Meridian International(=Meridian Regional Airport), Harbor East, North Valley, Lakeside Regional, Southport. Business Rules Registry: thresholds, connection/gate/towing/stand rules, border states, CTT tolerance, swap rules; which infrastructure events need approval, are advisory, or auto-trigger Capacity Reduction State. Modes: Normal; Adverse Weather(shorter sweeps; lighting/nav limits assessed with ceiling/visibility/wind/runway surface before capacity release); Capacity Reduction State(binding metering; RFM may suspend swaps; Cedarbell keeps event as controlling assumption until authorized close/supersede); Recovery Phase; Contingency Fallback State(ADM declares after consulting RFM, Tower Supervisor, SSE; declaration names functions, area, duration, restoration authority; applies when Cedarbell lacks trusted automation; degraded operation=latency/unavailability/inconsistent outputs); Slot Compliance; Winter(MBO confirms). On restoration ADM confirms closure in Foxglove; Cedarbell returns resource to Normal/Recovery. Actors: RFM=Regional Flow Manager(swap disputes; reviews constraints; confirms revised AAR); Airspace Sector Planner; Military Airspace Liaison; Tower Supervisor(stand readiness; rejects unsafe swaps; Runway Lighting Outage Card); ADM=Airport Duty Manager(Medical Diversion Notice, Customs Hold Release Note; enters service reductions); Ramp Control Lead(Apron Sweep Completion Note; Ramp Movement Board); Ground Handling Dispatcher(Towbar Shortage Report; Handling Resource Planner); Aircraft Operator Rep(Crew Duty Extension Log); Airline Operations Coordinator(TOBT; swaps); Slot Coordinator(Slot Swap Permission Email); NOL=Network Operations Liaison; SSE=System Support Engineer; Emergency Response Coordinator; Deicing Coordinator; MBO=Meteorology Briefing Officer; Data Governance Steward(infrastructure event data quality). Parts: Cedarbell=Regional Flow Platform(records infrastructure constraints); Airline Interface Adapter; Sector Load Monitor; Marlinstone=Demand Prediction Service; CAM=Capacity Assessment Module(AAR; Arrival Regulation Console); Weather Ingest Gateway; Blueharbor=Slot Allocation Engine(CTT=Calculated Takeoff Time; GDP; Pushback Window Token; swaps); Foxglove=Airport CDM Portal(TOBT; Collaborative Decision Log records publication time, approving role, capacity effect, services, amendments; Identity Access Service); Emberline=Departure Metering Service(CTT→Ironleaf=Tower Sequence Manager); Common Situation Display(resource, start/review time, status); Alert Distribution Hub(notifies constraint

New part:
S720: If the Airport CDM Portal becomes unavailable, participants continue coordination through the Digital Briefing Room and record decisions in the Collaborative Decision Log when service is restored.
S721: If the Demand Prediction Service or Capacity Assessment Module is unreliable, the Regional Flow Manager applies the last verified Airport Capacity Plan and adjusts it by direct coordination with the Airspace Sector Planner and Meteorology Briefing Officer.
S722: If the Slot Allocation Engine is unavailable, the Slot Coordinator initiates manual slot procedures using a time-ordered control sheet maintained at the Contingency Operations Console.
S723: Manual slot procedures preserve the most recent valid Calculated Takeoff Time unless safety, capacity, curfew, or regulatory constraints require a new time.
S724: The Slot Coordinator assigns any revised Calculated Takeoff Time only after confirming runway capacity with the Tower Supervisor and surface feasibility with the Ramp Control Lead.
S725: The Airline Operations Coordinator and Aircraft Operator Representative acknowledge manual slot assignments through recorded voice readback or an agreed written channel.
S726: The Slot Coordinator uses the Crew Duty Extension Log to check whether manually issued slot times remain operationally achievable.
S727: During manual operation, the Tower Sequence Manager and Ramp Movement Board are treated as advisory displays unless their data quality has been confirmed by the System Support Engineer.
S728: The Departure Metering Service may remain in monitoring mode while manual slot control is active, but it must not automatically overwrite issued times.
S729: The Arrival Regulation Console may continue to display arrival demand, but the Regional Flow Manager approves any arrival regulation changes through direct coordination.
S730: Fallback entry criteria include loss of authentication through the Identity Access Service, loss of time alignment from the Time Synchronization Service, corrupted operational data, or a sustained mismatch between surveillance and flight data.
S731: Fallback entry also occurs when the Alert Distribution Hub cannot deliver mandatory operational advisories to the required participants within the agreed operational tolerance.
S732: The System Support Engineer classifies the technical condition, isolates failed components, and advises whether partial restoration is safe for operational use.
S733: The Data Governance Steward confirms which data sets may be trusted and marks any later synchronization from fallback records for reconciliation review.
S734: The Airport Duty Manager conducts fallback briefings at intervals appropriate to the traffic level and publishes the current operating basis through the Digital Briefing Room.
S735: Transition out of the Contingency Fallback State requires stable service performance, verified data consistency, successful user access, and agreement from the operational leads affected by the outage.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
